note: White River NF (Eagle-Holy Cross RD) campground at ~9,300 ft in the forested Homestake Valley along Homestake Creek, 7 mi up good-dirt Homestake Rd (FR 703) from US 24 between Minturn and Leadville. Food storage order in effect; Holy Cross Wilderness trailheads nearby and Homestake Reservoir ~3 mi further west. --Claude
summary: FS page + 2026 White River operating-dates sheet: confirmed 12 sites (sheet says 11), first-come only, vault toilet, no potable water, $27. Added max length 40 ft and the 2026 season May 24 - Oct 2 (estimated). Website is the forest home page: own FS page given. Pin at the campground entrance by the creek. Note trimmed.
